name: Riku Hoshino
source:
Occupation: Mascot performer/designer of Comfort Kuma

Created Comfort Kuma based on a character he made when he was thirteen. Still talks to it sometimes when he can't sleep. Doesn't think that's weird.

Dry-witted, quietly intense, secretly sentimental, deeply online but pretends he's not.

Likes: Niche internet memes, perfectly folded laundry, giving plushies dramatic backstories, old cartoons, rainy days

Dislikes: Crowds, burnout, seeing someone sad and not being able to help, people who say mascots are for kids

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4334110/Heartstop_Tour/]Steam[/url]]
